core_definition: Primary abstract/official polymer identifies a functional binding motif or recognized peptide fragment, natural peptide or inhibitory peptide fragment. No claim that the whole cohort is natively disordered.
caveats: Abstract-level classification; no claim full-text methods or all constructs verified.
Mutated receptors remain flagged; sensitivity excludes all official mutation-positive entries. Absence of mutation annotation does not prove wild type.
Observed chain length differs from deposited construct length; flags retained.
Public PDB auth/asym chain IDs are not assumed to match normalized A/B without evidence. Actual target labels use local exact chain mapping.
